name: Magpiaš
title: Priest in Ezra's time
summary: Magpiaš was one of the priests mentioned in connection with Ezra's reforms after the return from the Babylonian exile. He was among those who had taken foreign wives and committed to sending them away in accordance with the renewal of the covenant. His name appears in lists of those who participated in rebuilding the Jewish community after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among priests with foreign wives
keyEvents.description: Magpiaš was one of the priests who had taken foreign wives in violation of God's law and was confronted about this during Ezra's reforms.

keyEvents.title: Participation in the renewal of the covenant
keyEvents.description: Magpiaš was among those who committed to following God's law and sending away their foreign wives as part of the people's repentance.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Nehemiah's list
keyEvents.description: Magpiaš is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah among those who sealed the covenant with God during the great renewal of promises.

keyEvents.title: Ezra's reading of the law
keyEvents.description: In connection with the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls, the priests, including Magpiaš, took part in reading God's law to the people.

keyEvents.title: The Dedication of the Wall of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The priests, including Magpiash, took part in the solemn dedication of the rebuilt city wall in Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.
